feeds.title: Vicky Myers creations
feeds.description: I enjoy sewing, especially with preloved fabric. A love of recycling and caring for the environment is the perfect excuse to haunt charity shops for bargains! Follow my creative journey, sewing, upcycling and experimenting.

feeds.title: Almond Rock
feeds.description: Covers all about Amy's sewing adventures, who is obsessed with all things sewing plus fluffy cats and gin cocktails!

feeds.title: The Thrifty Stitcher Blog
feeds.description: Hello! Learn to sew with me Claire-Louise Hardie, The Sewing Producer and Mastermind for The Great British Sewing Bee! I'm a Professional Stitcher with a passion for teaching beginners to sew!

feeds.title: Bobbins & Buttons Blog
feeds.description: Julia writes a blog that includes free projects, sewing techniques and her ongoing handmade wardrobe. From absolute beginner to the more established sewer.

feeds.title: Sewdirect Blog
feeds.description: The UK's biggest pattern house. Featuring all your favorite brands under one roof. Let us inspire your next sewing adventure. Read our blog to view different patterns and obtain quality information.

feeds.title: Sewbox - News
feeds.description: The ultimate way to shop online for sewing, dressmaking, crafting, quilting and haberdashery supplies.

feeds.title: Jaycotts Blog
feeds.description: Follow us for some great product tutorials, sewing machine reviews and handy things like that. Bernina, Janome and Brother Sewing Machines sewing supplies plus haberdashery, threads a massive choice of zips and sewing patterns selling online.

feeds.title: Sew Different
feeds.description: Sew Different is dedicated to home sewing and homemade fashion. Packed full of inspiration, tips, tutorials, and free sewing patterns. Authored by Laura Casey.

feeds.title: It's Sew Simple Blog
feeds.description: It's Sew Simple is a mobile sewing school teaching sewing & textiles decorative techniques to all. We exhibit at various events & craft fairs in London. I love to teach simple ways to tackle difficult sewing techniques, developing your confidence and broadening sewing skills.

feeds.title: Homespun Stitchworks
feeds.description: Dive into a blog dedicated to slow stitching enthusiasts and vintage aficionados, where a realm of possibilities and whimsy unfolds. Author Sarah Hawkings is a passionate creator with a soul deeply intertwined with crafting, also indulges in the art of treasure-hunting for exquisite old fabrics, buttons, linens, and threads.

feeds.title: Sewisfaction Blog
feeds.description: Sewisfaction is an independent fabric and sewing studio focused on bringing you beautiful dressmaking fabrics, inspiring sewing patterns and unique haberdashery products. We're also spreading the joy of sewing at our dressmaking classes aimed at complete beginners through to more advanced sewists. Our mission is to spread the feeling of Sewisfaction to as many people as possible!

feeds.title: Sewrendipity
feeds.description: Sewing is my superpower and I'm using it for good! It helps me curb my fashion consumption whilst still having a stylish wardrobe. It enables me to teach others to be creative and sew their own clothes too. Join me in 'sewing for good' to cut, stitch, refashion, make, learn, teach, ditch fast-fashion.

feeds.title: Diary of a Chain Stitcher
feeds.description: Covers articles all about sewing successes and failures, discovering lovely new fabrics and construction techniques! Diary of a Chainstitcher is a blog about learning new sewing techniques and taking on challenging projects.

feeds.title: The CoolCrafting Blog
feeds.description: Contemporary innovative crafting & sewing brand with inspirational workshops from CoolCrafting. From articles on needlework, fabrics & accessories through to felting and weaving, we cover all kinds of great articles in our blog.

feeds.title: More Sewing Blog
feeds.description: Love sewing? We are a haberdashery and dress fabric shop with sewing classes. We sell sewing machines, with in-house sewing machine servicing. Find informaton about new fabrics, products and guides to help you to be better at dressmaking and sewing.

feeds.title: And she made
feeds.description: I like to sew and you'll often find me on Pinterest, planning my next make. I also love to explore and discover new places, but sometimes I just like to escape to the countryside to relax. Beside the sea is where you'll find me at my calmest and most creative. I document my adventures in sewing, crafting, vintage fashion and life in general on this blog.

feeds.title: Self Assembly Required
feeds.description: I'm Emily, a self confessed sewing addict. I love designing and making clothes, pattern hacking and rambling on about fabric. This blog is all about sharing my love for sewing and all things crafty!

feeds.title: The Yorkshire Sewist Measure twice, Cut once, Curse, Repeat.
feeds.description: Welcome to The Yorkshire Sewist! I'm a Sewing Blogger and Simplicity Sewing Expert. Loves not to be 'normal' and cute things!!

feeds.title: Crafty Sewing Sew
feeds.description: I am self-employed and run a blog called Crafty Sewing Sew. I love sewing, making and creating. Blog by Helen Barrass.

feeds.title: Sew School
feeds.description: At Sew School you can learn how to use a sewing machine in a friendly and relaxed atmosphere. Classes are small to ensure you get all the individual attention you need. I want all my students to feel confident that they can use a sewing machine and excited about getting started on a project.

feeds.title: Creative Stitchers
feeds.description: Sewing lessons & courses for Cheshire. Learn sewing, dressmaking and much more in a bespoke studio from experts with years of experience.

feeds.title: Sew Smart A sewing blog
feeds.description: Find sewing tips and tutorials written and edited by Fraggle.

feeds.title: Sew Projects
feeds.description: Sew Projects is here to give you confidence in making your own lingerie. With Sew Projects patterns and sewing kits you can follow the easy guidelines or add a touch of your own creativity, creating a masterpiece that you are proud of.

feeds.title: Wendy Ward
feeds.description: Covers articles on all things sewing related, from reviews of books, reader makes & hacks and insights about the sewing and fashion industries.

feeds.title: Handmade Jane
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jane and I make my own clothes. My love affair with sewing began in 2009 when I took a beginners dressmaking course and made my first A-line skirt. I was hooked from the very first class and have been gradually adding to my handmade wardrobe ever since, sewing clothes to suit my body shape and my own personal style.

feeds.title: Sew Essential Blog
feeds.description: Covers sewing tips, tutorials, dressmaking patterns, sewing machines, fabrics, haberdashery and much more.

feeds.title: Love Sewing
feeds.description: Each issue is packed with tips, tricks and clever ideas to keep you inspired month after month. Every issue includes free sewing patterns, the best tutorials from industry experts plus exciting projects and inspiring articles. Whether you're making unique garments, chic homeware and accessories, or fun embroidery projects, Love Sewing is the perfect addition to your sewing room.

feeds.title: Handmade by Ditsy-tulip - My Wonderful World of Sewing
feeds.description: Welcome to ditsy-tulip!! I started my sewing journey about 4 years ago, it was a slow but enjoyable one!I love to sew, I love to talk about sewing (a lot) and I love to help other people to learn how to sew. So, if you love to sew, love to talk about sewing or are looking to learn how to sew, yay its lovely to have you here.

feeds.title: The Fold Line Blog
feeds.description: Covers various sewing patterns, pattern reviews, high street trends, interviews, reviews and inspiration for your handmade wardrobe. The Fold Line is an online sewing community, uniting sewers!

feeds.title: Sew Over It Blog
feeds.description: We have two branches in Clapham and Islington, London and teach sewing classes for everyone, from beginners to advanced dressmakers. If you want to learn to sew, look no further. Check out our blog for the latest sewing and dressmaking patterns.

feeds.title: Sewyeah
feeds.description: what's going on in the sewyeah world now? This blog is a snapshot of the things I like, things I do and things I see.

feeds.title: Sewing Classes & Supplies Blog
feeds.description: Sew Confident Ltd is your one stop sewing shop. We provide a range of sewing supplies and classes set in a friendly and social environment. We know you have busy stressful lifestyles and we want to introduce you to a new hobby to help you learn, de-stress and be social!

feeds.title: CocoWawa Crafts
feeds.description: Buy the CocoWawa Crafts sewing patterns for women and kids. Classic lines with a twist to sew garments that make you smile. We guide you along the way with tips, step-by-step instructions and technical drawings. Check our blog and YouTube channel for tutorials!
